note: KDM2B-related neurodevelopmental disorder presents with subtle or mild facial dysmorphism and variable organ anomalies, making episignature profiling critical for molecular classification.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 21 individuals with heterozygous pathogenic KDM2B variants, individuals presented with developmental delay/intellectual disability, autism/ADHD, congenital heart/eye/urogenital anomalies, and subtle facial dysmorphism, with an established peripheral blood DNA methylation episignature used for classification.

source.title: Delineation of a KDM2B-related neurodevelopmental disorder and its associated DNA methylation signature
source.quote: Individuals in this cohort present with developmental delay and/or intellectual disability; autism; attention deficit disorder/attention deficit hyperactivity disorder; congenital organ anomalies mainly of the heart, eyes, and urogenital system; and subtle facial dysmorphism.

numbers.metric: total recruited individuals with KDM2B variants

evidence.text: Individuals with KDM2B CxxC variants exhibit mild facial dysmorphism alongside developmental delay, variable intellectual disability, and congenital heart defects in up to 78% of individuals, with a specific subepisignature.

source.title: KDM2B Variants in the CxxC Domain Impair Its DNA-Binding ...
source.quote: All individuals with CxxC variants presented with developmental delay, mainly in the speech and motor domain, in addition to variable intellectual disability and mild facial dysmorphism. Congenital heart defects were observed in up to 78% of individuals
